full_prompt_en: A square impressionistic oil painting shows two women seated side by side in tall sunlit grass, looking left toward a quiet blue shore. The upper background is a broad blue and lavender haze, with a low horizontal boundary that barely separates distant water from sky. Near the left middle, a few tiny pale upright marks sit along the far bank, softened almost into the atmosphere. The grassy slope rises behind the women on the right and falls toward the left, its green and straw-colored strokes filling most of the lower half. The farther woman sits just left of center in a navy dress and a wide pale straw hat. Her face is seen in profile beneath the brim, and dark hair descends near the neck. One gloved hand rests in her lap, while the blue skirt folds into the grass around her. To the right, the nearer woman wears a white high-neck blouse and a full pale cream skirt. Brown hair gathers at the back of her head, and her body turns left in the same direction as her companion. Her hand presses into the grass behind her for support, allowing the torso to lean slightly back. Strong sunlight from the upper left and front gives the white blouse and skirt a golden glow and catches the brim of the hat. The blue dress remains cooler, providing a dark anchor beside the bright fabric. Brush strokes stay loose across the grass and distant shore, while shorter, more exact touches form the faces and upper garments. The lower-right grass falls into deep green shadow, and scattered tiny yellow flecks suggest flowers or sunlit stems. There are no strong linear borders between the figures and their setting; cloth and vegetation meet in soft broken edges. The overall composition places two calm silhouettes between a luminous blue distance and a textured green slope, with light cream and navy giving the quiet scene its balance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形印象派油画描绘两位女子并肩坐在高高的日照草丛中，望向左侧安静的蓝色水岸。上方背景是一大片蓝紫薄雾，低低的水平边界几乎不分开远处水面和天空。左中部附近，远岸几道细小浅色竖痕几乎柔化进空气。草坡在女子身后右侧抬起，向左下降，绿与稻草色笔触填满下半幅大部分。坐得稍远的女子位于中央偏左，穿藏蓝裙和宽浅色草帽。帽檐下可见侧脸，深发垂到颈边。一只戴手套的手放在腿上，蓝裙在身周折入草中。右侧较近的女子穿白色高领上衣和宽大浅奶油色长裙。棕发收在脑后，身体与同伴一样朝左。她的一只手撑在身后的草地上，使上身略向后倚。强烈日光从左上与正前方来，让白上衣和裙子呈金色光泽，也照亮草帽边缘。蓝裙保持更冷，成为亮衣旁的深色支点。草地和远岸的笔触松散，较短更准确的笔触构成脸及上衣。右下草丛落入深绿阴影，散落的小黄点暗示花朵或受光草茎。人物与环境之间没有强硬线界；布料与植物在柔软断续的边缘相接。整体构图把两道安静剪影放在明亮蓝色远景与带肌理绿坡之间，浅奶油色和藏蓝色赋予静景平衡。
style_prompt_en: The image has a luminous impressionistic oil-painted surface, with broken brush strokes merging neighboring colors at the edges. Cool blue and lavender open the upper area, while textured olive and straw green fill the lower region. A compact deep navy mass balances a larger cream and pale gold area, giving the otherwise soft palette a clear hierarchy. Directional marks follow broad slopes and folds, but distant details dissolve into atmospheric haze. Bright daylight from an upper side catches exposed light planes and makes small yellow flecks shimmer across darker textured areas. Shadows remain colored in blue green and olive rather than flat black. Shallow overlapping forms sit before an expansive, almost boundaryless distance. The overall effect is airy and reflective, with light and brush texture linking large color regions.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有明亮的印象派油画表面，断续笔触让相邻颜色在边缘交融。冷蓝与薰衣草色打开上方区域，带肌理的橄榄绿和稻草绿填满下方。紧凑的深藏蓝块平衡更大的奶油色与浅金色面积，让原本柔和的配色有清楚层级。有方向的笔痕顺着宽坡与褶面延伸，远处细节却融入空气薄雾。来自上方一侧的明亮日光照亮浅色受光平面，让小黄点在更暗的带纹理区域间闪动。阴影保留蓝绿与橄榄色，而非平板黑色。浅层叠形体位于几乎无边界的开阔远景前。整体效果通透而沉思，光和笔触肌理把大色域连在一起。
theme_en: Two women sitting in sunlit grass and looking across a blue shore
theme_zh: 两位女子坐在日照草坡上，望向蓝色水岸
name: Edmund Tarbell
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
